question: Should OpenClaw adopt a public plugin manifest/API contract and durable operator-query surface for AI safety events now, and if so what retention, privacy, and authorization guarantees are required?
rationale: This PR creates new extensibility, persisted-data, and operator-observability contracts; code review cannot safely choose their long-term product and security semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve and specify the contract
options.body: Adopt the capability after defining allowed event classes, provenance semantics, retention/privacy rules, upgrade behavior, and required validation.

options.title: Land core-only observability later
options.body: Keep event production internal and defer plugin emission, durable history, and UI/operator querying until those public contracts have an owner-approved design.

options.title: Route extensibility outside core
options.body: Keep core diagnostic seams generic and let optional safety-policy integrations live in plugins after a narrower SDK need is established.

recommendation.title: Approve and specify the contract
recommendation.body: Adopt the capability after defining allowed event classes, provenance semantics, retention/privacy rules, upgrade behavior, and required validation.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available routing candidate as the linked issue author and author of the implementation series; a diagnostics/plugin API owner should co-decide the contract.
